verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's platform shows each entity's registrations and statuses in Entity Manager, with a per-entity map. It also delivers received legal documents electronically and gives visibility into approved filing documents. Team access is only implied by annual report reminders being "customizable by user". missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-user/team seats and permissions on one shared account, evidence that received registered-agent documents sit in the same account view as entities and registrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I manage all entities, state registrations, and received documents from one account my team can access

citations.quote: Entity Manager automatically displays your registrations, statuses, and key data
Visualize your registrations for each entity on an interactive map.
Receive critical legal documents electronically and be notified by phone when you receive service of process
Identify registrations across states, monitor entity statuses, and receive precise annual report reminders customizable by user.
See due dates, filing status, approved documents, and more.
